summary: Phase III.6 (Claims & Grant Workflow + body_id migration) backend tests — 47/47 PASSED (100%). Validated version=3.6.0, body_id field on every record across all 7 collections, claims CRUD + filters + stats, full happy-path lifecycle (Draft→Submitted→Division_Recommended→MPCA_Sanctioned→Disbursed), all workflow guards, return-and-resubmit, reject at 3 stages, and full Phase I-III.5 regression suite. The 4 seeded demo claims (CLM-2025-26-001..004) remain intact in their original statuses (Draft/Submitted/Division_Recommended/Disbursed) — all stateful tests used TEST_ prefixed throwaway claims.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1881 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Should be split into routers (claims_routes.py, body_routes.py, member_routes.py, seed.py, models.py).

TestWorkflowGuards.test_cannot_submit_twice technically exposes that submit allows Returned state too (not just Draft) — that is intentional per spec (line 1132 in server.py) and works as designed; no fix needed.

Submit route accepts Draft AND Returned (line 1132). The spec phrasing 'cannot submit a non-Draft claim' is therefore slightly loose — the implementation is correct for the resubmit-after-return flow, just worth documenting.
Reject endpoint correctly blocks Disbursed/Rejected (line 1218) — also implicitly blocks Returned, which is reasonable.

No de-duplication on claim_no — _next_claim_no relies on count_documents, which is race-prone under concurrent POSTs. For demo scale this is fine; for production consider an atomic counter document or unique-index + retry.
test_credentials: none required — no auth on these endpoints
seed_data_creation: Test suite created 15 TEST_ prefixed throwaway claims in various lifecycle stages during runs. The 4 demo seed claims (CLM-2025-26-001..004) are untouched and remain in their original states.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase III.6 backend is solid. Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_6_claims.py and can be re-run regression-style. The TEST_ prefixed claims will accumulate in DB across runs — if cleanup is desired, add a fixture to delete claims where title startswith 'TEST_'. The 4 demo claims must stay untouched for the demo. Next phase should likely be the frontend UI for the Claims module (queues, action modals, approval chain timeline).
